text:
claire: Quick sync from the field — pilots keep asking for deterministic outbound plus a "no-surprises" upgrade path. They call it 'installer confidence'. We need firm acceptance criteria today.

omar: From eng: two routes to deterministic egress: operator relay (we run a small egress proxy) or customer SNAT/SNAT rules. Relay ships faster for complex topologies but adds a support surface and latency.

vince: UX ask: add a single "Network health" card in the admin console that shows Mode (relay/SNAT), pinned IPs, preflight status (OK/WARN/FAIL) and a one-click "Remediate" that expands to a checklist. Keep copy terse for netops.

yasmin: Security note: BYOK is non-negotiable for one pilot. MVP support should be single-key BYOK for at-rest encryption with clear docs that keys never leave customer control. No multi-key rotation in MVP.

release-bot: CI: bundle-3900001200 published to staging. smoke: 22/24. failing: windows preflight port probe flaky on ICMP/UDP.

ian: Rollout proposal: dogfood in house -> 2 invited pilots -> GA. Gates: signed bundle + preflight reliability >95% in staging, upgrade e2e (no egress flip), and runbook signed off.

claire: Acceptance criteria (draft): 1) preflight returns actionable remediation lines (example: "ALLOW outbound 203.0.113.12:443 from installer host"); 2) installer supports pinning egress IP(s) that persist across upgrades; 3) airgap bundle with signature + manifest; 4) BYOK single-key flow documented and tested; 5) compact telemetry parity: token-level latency/cost traces retained 7 days.

omar: Perf note: relay expected latency add: US ~+50-70ms, EU ~+80-110ms, APAC ~+120ms. We'll publish a small matrix and offer a per-tenant latency threshold that triggers an optional local-model fallback.

vince: Upgrade UX: allow admin to schedule a maintenance window or hit manual apply. During upgrades show per-tenant progress and an explicit "Abort and rollback" CTA. Installer should support --dry-run.

yasmin: Legal wants a short explainer for BYOK lifecycle and an attestation for airgap bundle provenance. We'll draft that.

ian: Action items: 1) omar -> relay PoC + perf matrix by Fri; 2) omar + infra -> fix windows preflight probe by Wed; 3) vince -> mock Network health card + copy by Tue; 4) yasmin -> BYOK sample config + legal note by Mon; 5) claire -> pilot comms + FAQ by Tue.

claire: Keep scope tight: MVP = signed bundles, airgap download, static egress bind (operator relay default for NATed installs), preflight with remediation, BYOK basic, in-place upgrades + rollback. Stretch: BGP, dynamic peering, multi-key BYOK.

ian: I'll capture this in the private-deploy roadmap doc and assign tickets. Tagging owners. :thumbsup:
